name: Stellar Cartography
tagline: Draws spacecraft and ships, then forces a second pair of eyes before release
description: Built for people who publish technical illustrations of hardware, whether that is a rocket, a satellite or a hull, where a wrong line in the drawing is the entire problem. Every image is held at a checking step and inspected again before it can go out, and jobs can be passed sideways to another bot on your roster.
author: Wil
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
